title.zh: EVE 学院：舰船装配入门

blocks.en: Bringing the right tools to a fight is key to winning.
blocks.zh: 带对工具上战场是取胜的关键。

blocks.en: Whether you're setting out on your next mission,
blocks.zh: 无论你是要去做下一个任务，

blocks.en: or diving into the unknowns of wormhole space,
blocks.zh: 还是深入未知的虫洞空间，

blocks.en: fitting your ship well is the best way to help ensure success.
blocks.zh: 把船装配好都是确保成功的最佳方法。

blocks.en: In this video,
blocks.zh: 在本视频中，

blocks.en: you'll learn about the fitting process,
blocks.zh: 你将了解装配流程，

blocks.en: and how you can design a ship to take on any challenge.
blocks.zh: 以及如何设计一艘足以应对任何挑战的舰船。

blocks.en: The first step to fitting for purpose is to pick the right ship for the task.
blocks.zh: 按用途装配的第一步，是为任务选对舰船。

blocks.en: When taking on missions, for example,
blocks.zh: 以任务为例，

blocks.en: you can start level 1 missions with just a Tech 1 frigate.
blocks.zh: 1 级任务只需一艘 T1 护卫舰就能开始。

blocks.en: As you progress to level 2 missions you should look to upgrading to a destroyer.
blocks.zh: 进阶到 2 级任务时，你应该考虑升级到驱逐舰。

blocks.en: Level 3 missions usually require at least a Tech 1 cruiser,
blocks.zh: 3 级任务通常至少需要一艘 T1 巡洋舰，

blocks.en: and level 4's are much more difficult,
blocks.zh: 而 4 级任务难度高得多，

blocks.en: requiring the use of a battleship.
blocks.zh: 需要使用战列舰。

blocks.en: When picking your ship, sometimes referred to as your hull,
blocks.zh: 挑选舰船（有时也称为船体）时，

blocks.en: take note of the ship bonuses seen in the 'Show Info' window in the traits tab.
blocks.zh: 留意「显示信息」窗口「特性（Traits）」标签页中的舰船加成。

blocks.en: Using modules to match these bonuses
blocks.zh: 使用与这些加成相匹配的装备，

blocks.en: is the best way to make sure that you're getting the most out of your fit.
blocks.zh: 是让你的装配发挥最大效果的最佳方式。

blocks.en: You can get further clues about how best to fit the ship
blocks.zh: 将鼠标悬停在该窗口顶部的「舰船特性（Ship Characteristics）」图标上，

blocks.en: by hovering over the 'Ship Characteristics' icon at the top of this window.
blocks.zh: 还能获得更多关于如何装配该船的提示。

blocks.en: When you're ready to start fitting,
blocks.zh: 准备开始装配时，

blocks.en: it can useful to begin with a simulated fit.
blocks.zh: 先从模拟装配入手会很有帮助。

blocks.en: To enter fitting simulation,
blocks.zh: 要进入装配模拟，

blocks.en: first open the fitting window,
blocks.zh: 先打开装配窗口，

blocks.en: then click on the 'Simulate' button in the top right.
blocks.zh: 然后点击右上角的「模拟（Simulate）」按钮。

blocks.en: This will show a holographic image of your ship,
blocks.zh: 这会显示你舰船的全息影像，

blocks.en: and a list of modules on the left hand side.
blocks.zh: 左侧则是装备列表。

blocks.en: Any changes you make now will not apply to your actual ship,
blocks.zh: 此时所做的任何改动都不会应用到你的实际舰船上，

blocks.en: allowing you to freely try out different options
blocks.zh: 让你可以自由尝试不同方案，

blocks.en: without having to buy all the modules first.
blocks.zh: 而不必先把装备全部买下来。

blocks.en: You can even use the 'Hulls & Fits' menu to create fits for ships you don't yet own,
blocks.zh: 你甚至可以使用「船体与装配（Hulls & Fits）」菜单为你还没有的舰船创建配置，

blocks.en: save your fits for future use,
blocks.zh: 保存配置以备日后使用，

blocks.en: or browse a selection of community-created fittings.
blocks.zh: 或浏览社区玩家创建的精选配置。

blocks.en: With your ship hull selected,
blocks.zh: 选好船体后，

blocks.en: you can now start adding modules to see how it performs.
blocks.zh: 就可以开始添加装备，看看它的表现如何。

blocks.en: You can browse modules on the left hand panel,
blocks.zh: 你可以在左侧面板中浏览装备，

blocks.en: and click 'Show Info' to get an idea of what they all do.
blocks.zh: 点击「显示信息」了解它们各自的作用。

blocks.en: Each module you add will take up some of the ship's power grid and processing power.
blocks.zh: 每添加一件装备，都会占用舰船的部分能量栅格和 CPU。

blocks.en: These are represented on the lower right.
blocks.zh: 这些显示在右下方。

blocks.en: Modules exceeding your power grid or CPU will be offline and unable to be used.
blocks.zh: 超出能量栅格或 CPU 上限的装备将处于离线状态，无法使用。

blocks.en: You can also see a breakdown of the ships stats in the panel on the right.
blocks.zh: 你还可以在右侧面板中查看舰船属性的详细数据。

blocks.en: Theorycrafting and fitting for PvE is a balancing act between four main pillars,
blocks.zh: PvE 的理论配船和装配，是在四大支柱之间寻求平衡：

blocks.en: as you improve one aspect of the fit,
blocks.zh: 当你提升配置的某一方面时，

blocks.en: you will probably need to make sacrifices in other areas to make it work.
blocks.zh: 很可能需要在其他方面做出牺牲才能让它成立。

blocks.en: The four pillars to balance any successful fit are:
blocks.zh: 任何成功配置都需要平衡的四大支柱是：

blocks.en: the amount of damage per second,
blocks.zh: 你的舰船能对目标打出的

blocks.en: or DPS, that your ship can apply on target,
blocks.zh: 每秒伤害，即 DPS；

blocks.en: your tank, meaning how much incoming damage your ship can survive,
blocks.zh: 你的坦度，也就是你的舰船能承受多少伤害；

blocks.en: your mobility, how quickly you can move around in space,
blocks.zh: 你的机动性，即你在太空中移动的速度；

blocks.en: and finally your capacitor,
blocks.zh: 最后是你的电容，

blocks.en: the energy your ship has to use modules while in space.
blocks.zh: 也就是舰船在太空中使用装备所需的能量。

blocks.en: For the first pillar, we have your outgoing damage.
blocks.zh: 第一大支柱是你的输出伤害。

blocks.en: There are many different weapon systems in EVE,
blocks.zh: EVE 中有许多不同的武器系统，

blocks.en: each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 各有优缺点。

blocks.en: Your choice of weapon type will be decided by the ship hull,
blocks.zh: 武器类型由船体决定，

blocks.en: but you can further specialize based on how you plan to fly your ship.
blocks.zh: 但你可以根据打算怎么开这艘船进一步细分。

blocks.en: Projectile weapons, for example, fit onto Minmatar ships,
blocks.zh: 例如，射弹武器适用于米玛塔尔舰船，

blocks.en: and are split into close-range autocannons or long-range artillery.
blocks.zh: 分为近程的自动加农炮和远程的火炮。

blocks.en: Weapons are always fitted into the high slots of your ship.
blocks.zh: 武器总是装在舰船的高槽中。

blocks.en: We can also use the low slots to add damage modules to make our guns hit harder.
blocks.zh: 我们还可以在低槽装上伤害增强装备，让炮打得更狠。

blocks.en: For our autocannons here,
blocks.zh: 针对这里的自动加农炮，

blocks.en: we are fitting two Tech 2 Gyrostabilizers
blocks.zh: 我们装了两个 T2 回转稳定器，

blocks.en: and loading close-ranged Fusion ammunition.
blocks.zh: 并装填近程的聚变弹（Fusion）。

blocks.en: This ammo primarily fires explosive which is effective against Angel Cartel pirates
blocks.zh: 这种弹药主要造成爆炸伤害，对天使企业联合体的海盗很有效，

blocks.en: information which can be found in the 'Show Info' panel
blocks.zh: 这些信息可以在点击任意 NPC 海盗后

blocks.en: when you click on any NPC pirate.
blocks.zh: 打开的「显示信息」面板中找到。

blocks.en: For the second pillar,
blocks.zh: 第二大支柱，

blocks.en: we want to focus on our defensive capability, our tank.
blocks.zh: 我们要关注防御能力，也就是坦度。

blocks.en: When improving the shields or armor of any ship,
blocks.zh: 在强化舰船的护盾或装甲时，

blocks.en: you can choose between using active modules such as a 'Shield Booster',
blocks.zh: 你可以选择使用主动装备，比如「护盾回充增量器（Shield Booster）」

blocks.en: or 'Armor Repairer',
blocks.zh: 或「装甲维修器（Armor Repairer）」，

blocks.en: or buffer modules like the 'Shield Extender' and 'Armor Plate'.
blocks.zh: 也可以选择缓冲装备，比如「护盾扩展装置」和「装甲附甲板」。

blocks.en: There is also a third kind of tank
blocks.zh: 还有第三种坦法，

blocks.en: that boosts the passive regeneration of your shield to stay alive.
blocks.zh: 即提升护盾的被动回复来维持生存。

blocks.en: For missions, you will likely want to use an active tank.
blocks.zh: 做任务时，你多半会想用主动坦。

blocks.en: This will allow you to repair your ship while in space and fighting,
blocks.zh: 这样你就能在太空中边战斗边修船，

blocks.en: instead of running away when your shield or armor are low.
blocks.zh: 而不必在护盾或装甲见底时逃跑。

blocks.en: Your choice in shield or armor is also usually decided by the ship hull,
blocks.zh: 选护盾还是装甲，通常也由船体决定，

blocks.en: and how many types of each slot it has.
blocks.zh: 取决于它各类槽位的数量。

blocks.en: Shield modules tend to use mid slots, and armor modules fit into low slots.
blocks.zh: 护盾装备一般使用中槽，装甲装备则装在低槽。

blocks.en: We'll use a 'Shield Booster' here to repair our shields,
blocks.zh: 这里我们用一个「护盾回充增量器」来修复护盾，

blocks.en: and a 'Hardener' module to improve our resists.
blocks.zh: 再用一个「强化（Hardener）」装备来提升抗性。

blocks.en: If you know which type of damage you will be taking,
blocks.zh: 如果你知道自己会承受哪种类型的伤害，

blocks.en: then you can fit specific resists here,
blocks.zh: 可以在这里装针对性的抗性装备，

blocks.en: but we're going to go with the 'Multispectrum Shield Hardener'
blocks.zh: 不过我们选择「多谱式护盾增强器」，

blocks.en: which boosts all resists simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 它能同时提升所有抗性。

blocks.en: It can also be useful to fit a 'Damage Control'.
blocks.zh: 装一个「损伤控制（Damage Control）」也很有用。

blocks.en: This module improves your shield, armor, and hull resists,
blocks.zh: 这件装备能提升护盾、装甲和结构的抗性，

blocks.en: and takes up a low slot, which we have plenty of.
blocks.zh: 占用一个低槽，而我们的低槽很充裕。

blocks.en: After fitting that 'Damage Control', we're now over on CPU.
blocks.zh: 装上「损伤控制」后，我们的 CPU 超了。

blocks.en: To fix that,
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题，

blocks.en: we're going to fill our last low slot with a new type of module,
blocks.zh: 我们要在最后一个低槽装一种新类型的装备：

blocks.en: a fitting module.
blocks.zh: 装配辅助装备。

blocks.en: In this case, we want a 'Co-Processor' to improve the ship's CPU output.
blocks.zh: 这里我们需要一个「协处理器（Co-Processor）」来提升舰船的 CPU 输出。

blocks.en: Now that we have tank and damage,
blocks.zh: 现在有了坦度和伤害，

blocks.en: we need to consider the third pillar, mobility.
blocks.zh: 我们需要考虑第三大支柱：机动性。

blocks.en: Our autocannons are short-ranged,
blocks.zh: 我们的自动加农炮射程很短，

blocks.en: and will only apply half their damage at their 10km falloff.
blocks.zh: 在 10km 的失准范围处只能打出一半伤害。

blocks.en: To make sure we can destroy pirates effectively,
blocks.zh: 为了确保能有效击毁海盗，

blocks.en: we're going to fit a 'Microwarpdrive'.
blocks.zh: 我们要装一个「微型跃迁推进器（Microwarpdrive）」。

blocks.en: This module will let us move extremely quickly to new targets
blocks.zh: 这件装备能让我们极快地移动到新目标处，

blocks.en: at the cost of high capacitor usage,
blocks.zh: 代价是消耗大量电容，

blocks.en: and an increased ship signature radius.
blocks.zh: 还会增大舰船的信号半径。

blocks.en: The alternative option to a 'Microwarpdrive' would be an 'Afterburner'
blocks.zh: 「微型跃迁推进器」的替代选择是「加力燃烧器（Afterburner）」，

blocks.en: which is slower,
blocks.zh: 它速度较慢，

blocks.en: but uses less capacitor and does not increase your signature.
blocks.zh: 但耗电更少，也不会增大信号半径。

blocks.en: Signature radius indicates how easy it is to target your ship.
blocks.zh: 信号半径表示你的舰船有多容易被锁定。

blocks.en: A smaller signature radius makes you hard to hit,
blocks.zh: 信号半径越小，你就越难被打中，

blocks.en: and allows you to take less damage from larger weapons.
blocks.zh: 受到大型武器的伤害也越少。

blocks.en: This can help you tank using signature or speed by getting under your opponents guns,
blocks.zh: 这能帮你靠信号半径或速度来抗伤，钻到对手的炮口之下，

blocks.en: effectively dodging their bullets.
blocks.zh: 有效地躲开他们的子弹。

blocks.en: Such a fit might also use a 'Nanofiber' to increase their speed and agility.
blocks.zh: 这类配置还可能使用「纳米纤维（Nanofiber）」来提升速度和灵活性。

blocks.en: We're going to keep the 'Microwarpdrive' for now,
blocks.zh: 我们暂时保留「微型跃迁推进器」，

blocks.en: but notice how it uses a lot of fitting,
blocks.zh: 但请注意它占用了大量装配资源，

blocks.en: and has overloaded our CPU once again.
blocks.zh: 又一次让 CPU 超标了。

blocks.en: Instead of using another fitting module,
blocks.zh: 这次我们不再加装配辅助装备，

blocks.en: we can instead try swapping out some of our Tech 2 modules
blocks.zh: 而是尝试把部分 T2 装备

blocks.en: for compact versions instead.
blocks.zh: 换成紧凑型版本。

blocks.en: In this case, we're going to use two 'Counterbalanced Compact Gyrostabilizers',
blocks.zh: 这里我们改用两个「反制性紧凑型回转稳定器」

blocks.en: and the 'IFFA Compact Damage Control'
blocks.zh: 和「IFFA 紧凑型损伤控制」，

blocks.en: which have slightly lower stats, but reduced fitting costs.
blocks.zh: 它们的属性略低，但装配需求也更低。

blocks.en: Finally, onto the last pillar.
blocks.zh: 最后，来到最后一大支柱。

blocks.en: We need to fix our capacitor,
blocks.zh: 我们需要解决电容问题，

blocks.en: the amount of energy our ship can use to activate modules.
blocks.zh: 也就是舰船启动装备所能使用的能量。

blocks.en: Right now it runs out in only 20 seconds
blocks.zh: 目前由于「护盾回充增量器」和「微型跃迁推进器」，

blocks.en: due to our 'Shield Booster' and 'Microwarpdrive'.
blocks.zh: 电容只能撑 20 秒。

blocks.en: We can start to fix that by using our rig slots.
blocks.zh: 我们可以先从改装件槽入手解决。

blocks.en: Rigs can improve nearly any function of your ship,
blocks.zh: 改装件几乎能提升舰船的任何功能，

blocks.en: but they cannot be removed without breaking them.
blocks.zh: 但一旦装上，拆下时就会损毁。

blocks.en: Fortunately, as this is a simulation,
blocks.zh: 幸好这是模拟，

blocks.en: we can test them before fitting them for real.
blocks.zh: 我们可以在真正装上之前先测试。

blocks.en: In this case,
blocks.zh: 这里，

blocks.en: we are going to use three small 'Capacitor Control Circuits'
blocks.zh: 我们要用三个小型「电容器控制电路（Capacitor Control Circuit）」

blocks.en: to improve our capacitor recharge speed.
blocks.zh: 来提升电容回充速度。

blocks.en: Our capacitor is still a bit unstable,
blocks.zh: 电容仍然有点不稳定，

blocks.en: so we're going to exchange some of our defence or 'tank' for capacitor
blocks.zh: 所以我们要拿一部分防御（即坦度）来换电容：

blocks.en: by dropping the 'Multispectrum Shield Hardener' for a 'Cap Recharger',
blocks.zh: 把「多谱式护盾增强器」换成「电容回充器（Cap Recharger）」，

blocks.en: making us cap stable.
blocks.zh: 让电容达到稳定。

blocks.en: Being fully cap stable isn't always necessary,
blocks.zh: 电容完全稳定并不总是必要的，

blocks.en: but it´s nice to have and prevents us from running into a situation
blocks.zh: 但有了更好，能避免

blocks.en: where our 'Shield Booster' stops working.
blocks.zh: 「护盾回充增量器」因没电而停止工作的情况。

blocks.en: There are plenty of other modules to improve your capacitor
blocks.zh: 还有很多其他提升电容的装备，

blocks.en: such as 'Cap Batteries', 'Cap Flux Coils', or 'Power Relays'.
blocks.zh: 比如「电容器电池」、「电容通量线圈」或「电容能源继电器」。

blocks.en: Each does something unique,
blocks.zh: 它们各有独特的作用，

blocks.en: so be sure to read the module descriptions.
blocks.zh: 一定要仔细阅读装备说明。

blocks.en: You may have noticed that doing this freed up a lot of CPU
blocks.zh: 你可能注意到，这样做释放了大量 CPU，

blocks.en: since the 'Cap Recharger' has lower fitting requirements.
blocks.zh: 因为「电容回充器」的装配需求较低。

blocks.en: We can now remove that 'Co-Processor' that we added earlier, freeing up a low slot.
blocks.zh: 现在我们可以拆掉之前加的「协处理器」，空出一个低槽。

blocks.en: This slot is an excellent place to put in an application module
blocks.zh: 这个槽位非常适合装一件命中辅助装备，

blocks.en: like the 'Tracking Enhancer'.
blocks.zh: 比如「索敌增强器（Tracking Enhancer）」。

blocks.en: This will improve the tracking of our guns
blocks.zh: 它能提升炮台的跟踪速度，

blocks.en: while also extending our range out to 12km.
blocks.zh: 同时把射程延长到 12km。

blocks.en: Good application of damage on target is vital in both PvE and PvP.
blocks.zh: 在 PvE 和 PvP 中，能把伤害有效打到目标身上都至关重要。

blocks.en: Your ship might have really high damage,
blocks.zh: 你的船可能伤害很高，

blocks.en: but if you can't hit small targets then you'll never destroy them.
blocks.zh: 但如果打不中小目标，就永远击毁不了它们。

blocks.en: Our fit is now complete.
blocks.zh: 我们的配置现在完成了。

blocks.en: We can now save it,
blocks.zh: 现在可以保存它，

blocks.en: drag the fit name into chat to share it,
blocks.zh: 把配置名称拖进聊天频道分享，

blocks.en: or even buy it all now with the 'Buy All' button.
blocks.zh: 甚至可以用「全部购买（Buy All）」按钮一键买齐。

blocks.en: There are more efficiency improvements you can make to your fit,
blocks.zh: 你的配置还可以做更多优化，

blocks.en: but figuring that out is the art of fitting itself.
blocks.zh: 而摸索这些正是装配本身的艺术。

blocks.en: This may involve getting out there,
blocks.zh: 这可能需要你亲自出去闯荡，

blocks.en: and seeing how different pirate factions behave,
blocks.zh: 看看不同的海盗势力如何行动，

blocks.en: and how you need to prepare yourself to deal with their damage types,
blocks.zh: 以及你该如何准备来应对它们的伤害类型

blocks.en: and electronic warfare.
blocks.zh: 和电子战。

blocks.en: Being properly prepared for a fight
blocks.zh: 为战斗做好充分准备，

blocks.en: is the key component to being successful as an Enforcer in EVE Online.
blocks.zh: 是在 EVE Online 中成为一名成功的执法者（Enforcer）的关键。
